name: Late-QE calm
rationale: Post-taper-tantrum low-vol; oil rangebound ~$100-115 into its June-2014 peak. Pre-crash baseline.

name: Oil crash / strong-USD bear
rationale: Brent ~$115→~$27; broad USD surge; OPEC inaction. Synchronized commodity bear, trough ~Feb-2016.

name: Reflation recovery
rationale: Commodity recovery, China stimulus, weak-USD 2017, synchronized global growth.

name: Trade war / late cycle
rationale: US-China tariffs, 2018-Q4 selloff, 2019 curve inversion. Ends at pre-COVID market peak.

name: COVID shock & rebound
rationale: Crash + reflation. Contains NEGATIVE WTI 2020-04-20 — extreme outlier for any oil-linked series.

name: Reflation & Ukraine supercycle
rationale: Post-COVID demand, supply chains, Russia-Ukraine (2022-02-24) energy/metals spike; commodity peak ~mid-2022.

name: Fed hiking / disinflation
rationale: Fastest Fed cycle; Mar-2023 bank stress; 10Y peaks ~5% Oct-2023; commodity normalization. (USD LIBOR ends 2023-06-30.)

name: Plateau & easing pivot
rationale: Higher-for-longer plateau into soft landing; first Fed cut Sep-2024.

name: Recent / study-window events
rationale: Contains your documented Hormuz energy shock, precious-metals blow-off & crash, and May cross-commodity decoupling. Sub-split once exact event dates are fixed.
